html:
• English is now the default interface language and comes first in the language lists (first-run wizard and System Settings). A language you have already chosen is not changed.
  • More complete translations in Files, System Settings and the shell: "Cut", "Open With…", view and sort menus, dialogs, status messages ("Cut: 3 items", "Copying “a” to “b”"), sizes with the right decimal separator, wallpapers, keyboard and notification settings, network errors, the calendar. Checked menu items are translated too.
  • Still Russian only: the featherctl command-line tool, the demo text of the text editor and log messages.
• White icons in the menu bar on the dark theme: the menu bar is always dark with white text and icons whatever the wallpaper, instead of turning black under a light sky.

• A more expressive Dock on the dark theme: the plates under Chrome, Firefox, Telegram and similar icons are darker than the Dock glass with a bright edge highlight, the icons are larger on them, square icons are rounded like the rest, and a soft shadow sits under the icons.

• Complete silence in Do Not Disturb: a new "Urgent notifications" switch in System Settings → Notifications. Turn it off and no banner appears in Do Not Disturb, even an urgent one; everything quietly collects in the Notification Center. On by default (behaviour unchanged).

• Arch Linux: one command installs everything. The install.sh one-liner now works on Arch and derivatives: it installs Feather, the app set (Firefox, LibreOffice, video, music, printing, codecs, Flatpak for the Store), interface locales, and on a system without a login screen — the Feather login screen. Feather only: … | bash -s -- --minimal.
  • Konsole and Dolphin on a KDE system no longer merge with Feather's Terminal and Files.

• Monitors on a second graphics card (a hybrid laptop with HDMI on the discrete card, a docking station) are detected and work as ordinary screens. Not yet tested on real two-GPU hardware; FEATHER_SINGLE_GPU=1 restores the old behaviour.
  • The "Russian — typewriter" keyboard layout (System Settings → Keyboard → Add).

• Tray icons share one style: app icons in the menu bar are made monochrome to match the panel text, as in macOS; coloured marks (a red unread dot) are kept. Original colours can be restored in System Settings.
  • The menu bar no longer turns light over a maximised light window.
  • Steam game icons in the Dock instead of a generic icon.

• Animation speed: a new slider in System Settings → Appearance, from 0.5× to 2×, speeds up or slows down all Feather animations together.
  • The lock screen on Astra Linux accepts the correct password again (the feather-lock PAM stack no longer includes a non-existent system-auth).

• Mouse wheel and touchpad scrolling in the modal pick lists of System Settings (time zone, autostart apps, default apps).
  • Files: pick any application, or type your own command, in "Open With…".
  • A smarter contrast algorithm for the menu bar and its menus over any wallpaper.

• The Drop Shelf remembers its position.
  • Moving a window to the Scratchpad with Super + Shift + S slides the Scratchpad out at once.
  • Open Terminal windows follow a theme change live.
  • A neutral bash prompt on a fresh Ubuntu.
  • Files: undo with Ctrl + Z.
  • Fullscreen for any app with Cmd + F (Super + F).
  • The menu bar menu takes on the tint of the wallpaper-based bar colour.
  • Fixes for Steam DISPLAY, linux-drm-syncobj and black Zen/Firefox windows (a community pull request).

• A tidier Control Center: cards with a highlighted edge, round toggle pills, sliders with a knob, cover art on the "Now Playing" card; "Do Not Disturb" and "Dark Mode" labels are no longer cut off. Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth and Sound pages get a back button, arc signal strength, device-type icons with a battery and a checkmark on the active item.
  • Menu bar: new speaker and Do Not Disturb icons; icons no longer shift when the minute changes.

• Security: caller authorisation on the private and control D-Bus interfaces. Only the real portal backend can use org.feather.ScreenCast1, only xdg-desktop-portal can call the portal backend, and org.feather.Shell1 rejects calls from sandboxes (Flatpak, Snap, xdg-dbus-proxy) and respects the screen-capture ban.
• Flatpak and Snap app icons in the Feather shell (including apps installed from Flathub, such as Zen Browser).

• Flathub in the built-in Store: one-click connection, a "System package / Flathub" choice for programs available from both, installing, launching, removing and updates.
  • A built-in interactive "Feather Keyboard Shortcuts" cheat-sheet window.
• A central glass HUD plate when switching workspaces: the number, page dots and the current layout mode.

• Direct workspace switching with Cmd + 1…9; a missing space is created on the fly and empty trailing spaces collapse when you leave.
  • Moving the active window to a space with Cmd + Shift + 1…9, following it.
  • Screen Recording moved to ⌥⌘5.

• Workspace modes (Ctrl + Alt + M): each space works independently as free windows, automatic tiling with draggable dividers, or an infinite scrollable ribbon in the style of PaperWM / Niri.
  • Live Liquid Glass on the GPU: panels, Dock, menus, Spotlight, Control Center and Notification Center refract and blur the live picture under them.
  • Drop Shelf: a shelf for dragged files, images and text, summoned by shaking the cursor.
  • Menu command search (Super + /): an instant palette of the active window's menu commands.
  • Picture in Picture and Ghost PiP (Super + P / Super + Alt + P).
  • A per-app audio mixer: volume, mute and output device for each program.

• Full control of Scratchpad tiles: navigation, swapping, live divider resizing from the keyboard and mouse, 50/50 equalising and fullscreen for a tile.
  • A fix for the resize cursor disappearing at window borders, including in DRM.
• Session logs no longer grow without limit; the global menu of Qt apps no longer accumulates closed windows; scrolling dense lists on 4K in built-in apps can no longer hang.

• A noticeably faster, smoother desktop: no idle render passes on captured-mouse motion in games, key presses and trackpad scrolling.
  • Less memory and bandwidth on HiDPI/4K: notifications and Mission Control labels use compact buffers.
• Arch Linux: our own pacman repository [feather-de] with updates via sudo pacman -Syu and one-command installation.
• Downloading files from Codex Desktop and other Electron programs: the save dialog opens even if the program passed only a file name.
• Windows are easier to resize: wider grab zones on edges and corners, the same behaviour for all windows including those with their own frames, min/max sizes respected.

• Fixed a whole-desktop crash when hovering a Dock icon whose name is wider than the panel.
  • Files, Preview, Text Editor, Monitor, Store, Notes and Calculator report only the changed part of the window: fewer stalls, especially in maximised 4K windows.

• Screen Recording: fixed a green screen with artefacts in HEVC video (4K on AMD cards).
  • Notifications can be closed with the cross over the Scratchpad too.
• Screen Recording without freezes: the graphics card encodes the video (VAAPI H.264, HEVC for 4K), correct colours (BT.709), microphone in sync, a keyframe every 2 s.
• The app ring no longer reorders programs: each has a fixed place like in the Dock. Switching only by an explicit action: a click or Enter.

• The app ring: a short press of Cmd (Super) lays out the open programs in a circle around the cursor. "Cmd, Cmd" goes back to the previous program; choose with the mouse, arrows, Tab, the wheel or the first letter. Can be turned off in System Settings → Keyboard.

• GTK 3/4 apps without their own header (dialogs, simple windows) get the same Feather title bar with traffic lights as Qt and built-in windows, including the tiling menu on the green button. GTK snap apps get the macOS-style buttons too.
• Caps Lock can be chosen as the language switch; it works like in macOS: a tap switches the language, holding turns capitals on.

• Files: window buttons in the title bar and the folder sidebar as a separate card below.
  • Wallpapers 2.0: a preview monitor with the real picture, fill/fit/stretch scaling, auto-change, all gradients as separate tiles.
  • Five new wallpapers: Waves, Dunes, Ridges, Emerald, Graphite.

• Ilya Birman's typographic keyboard layout on the right Alt.
  • Flatpak and Snap browsers (such as Zen) can be the default browser.
  • A clear notification if xwayland-satellite is missing.
• A Terminal with a single tab has no tab bar; a second tab opens with a tidy "+" in the title bar.

• macOS Tahoe-style Terminal tabs; a blue dot marks a background tab with new output.
  • The Caffeine icon is a cup on a saucer, no longer confused with the battery.

• Files open and extract RAR archives themselves (RAR4, RAR5, multi-part, password-protected).
  • Files: extracting all archives and "Compress" work again in a real window.
  • Chrome and other Chromium windows no longer leave a gap above the Dock when they open maximised.
• The Scratchpad (Super + S) opens faster and no longer stutters if Alt+Tab follows at once.
• The Scratchpad: a layer of windows above all spaces. Super + S shows it, Super + Shift + S moves the focused window there and back.

• Window tiling to halves and quarters (edges, the green-button menu, the Window menu, Ctrl + Super + arrows).
  • Windows reopen where they were and at their old size; the previous session returns at login.
  • Spotlight searches open windows, settings sections, notes and home-folder files.
• Larvis can change the Dock position through the desktop API.
• FEATHER_AUTOMATION=1 enables window screenshot, click, scroll, keyboard and text-paste methods of the desktop API for application automation.

• The org.feather.Shell1 desktop API on the D-Bus session bus (windows, spaces, Mission Control and Launchpad, apps, sound, brightness, night mode, dark theme, Do Not Disturb, media, screenshots, lock and sleep) and the featherctl tool. The voice assistant Larvis drives the desktop through it.

• Clipboard: ext-data-control and wlr-data-control support (wl-copy/wl-paste, clipboard managers, images pasted into other Wayland programs).
  • Files: text selection by dragging in rename, search and path fields.

• A task manager, System Monitor, on Ctrl + Alt + Del: processes with CPU and memory, sorting, search, "Quit Process" and CPU/memory/disk/network graphs.
  • Lock, screen blanking and sleep can be postponed for 2 or 5 hours.
• Files show extraction progress with an "X of Y — about N min left" card and a cancel button.

• Files extract all common archives (single gz, xz, bz2, zst, cab, arj, lzh, cpio, ace); Windows zips with Russian names extract correctly; an archive opened from another program is extracted next to it at once.
• On the dark Dock, round and non-square icons (for example Chrome) no longer blend into the background.

• Files see all disks and flash drives, not only mounted ones: a click mounts, ⏏ safely ejects.
  • A "Now Playing" tile in Control Center: track, artist, ⏮ ⏯ ⏭.
• Files extract RAR archives, including RAR5 and multi-part ones; encrypted RAR, zip and 7z ask for a password; zip with a password no longer hangs.

• Autostart programs start after you enter your password, not on the login screen.
  • If a program does not open, the reason stays in ~/.local/state/feather-de/apps.log.
• After logging out and in again, Telegram, MouseVPN and other single-instance programs start again: on logout Feather closes the programs it started.
• The Store: a new app in the Dock and Launchpad with a featured selection, categories, search and program pages. Install and remove in one click.

• Minimised windows, windows on other spaces and windows under a fullscreen game are no longer drawn needlessly at the display rate: a browser with a video in the Dock no longer loads the CPU and GPU.
  • Dock icon magnification on hover is done by the GPU.
• Launching Codex, Antigravity, Chromium and other Electron apps no longer blocks the screen.

• The icon of a just-installed program appears in the Dock and Launchpad at once.
  • Files: the context menu widens for long items, and a too-long name is ellipsised.
• Files: "Open With…" in a file's context menu, listing the programs that can open that type.
• Files: rename by a slow click on a selected name (like Finder) and Ctrl+C/X/V in the name, path and search fields, including in the Russian layout.
• One-command installation; the .deb adds the repository itself; the feather-desktop metapackage with programs like Ubuntu Desktop; xwayland-satellite inside the package; running AppImage from Files.

• In the APT repository: native Wayland Electron/Chromium, bicubic scaling of legacy programs, .deb from the browser, a compatibility check in the installer, an archiver in Files, Ctrl+letter in the Russian layout.
• The first version in the APT repository https://zumka1991.github.io/feather-de. Repository signing key: D5E6 C262 8719 EF1D 6068 5758 C7F9 44C1 485C 5FC4.
